name: Prune2TargetSize
definition: An algorithm to reduce a pretrained 3DGS model to a precise target number of splats (d) while maintaining visual quality, using a top-down approach of pruning low-significance splats followed by recovery training.
summary: Prune2TargetSize is a top-down algorithm that precisely reduces a 3D Gaussian Splatting model to a specific splat count via iterative pruning and recovery, unlike standard methods that cannot guarantee exact sizes.
